The mass is painless and has caused a rapid increase in size over just 4 weeks, yet you report no skin changes or nipple discharge. Do you have any history of lymph node enlargement in your armpit or neck, and have you experienced any recent weight loss or fatigue?

speaker: Doctor

The mammogram shows a smooth, polylobulated mass in the left breast. Given the rapid growth over four weeks without skin changes, have you noticed any clear fluid leaking from the nipple, and do you have any history of taking hormone replacement therapy or using oral contraceptives?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: The ultrasound demonstrates a hypoechoic, well-circumscribed mass with posterior acoustic enhancement. The mass exhibits a narrow base and a "teardrop" appearance with leaf-like projections into the surrounding tissue. Internal vascularity is noted on Doppler imaging.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor of the left breast.

The ultrasound findings of a well-circumscribed, hypoechoic mass with a narrow base, teardrop appearance, and leaf-like projections are classic for a Phyllodes tumor, especially given the rapid growth rate over four weeks. I have reached my diagnostic conclusion based on the clinical history and imaging results, so I will not ask any further questions.
